WHO WE ARE:

BITKRAFT Ventures is a global leader in early-stage investments at the intersection of gaming, Web3, and immersive technologies. With over $1B in assets under management and 130+ portfolio companies, we empower visionary founders to shape the future of interactive entertainment and digital economies.

We are a diverse, distributed team united by a shared mission: to identify and support innovative startups that will define the future of virtual worlds, economies, and experiences. At BITKRAFT, we focus on early-stage investments that fuel the convergence of physical and digital realities, a concept we call Synthetic Reality.

We are excited to meet candidates who are passionate about shaping the future of gaming and immersive technologies and are eager to join our dynamic, fast-growing team.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for an experienced AI-Driven Software Engineer to join our distributed development team.

You should have a strong software engineering background, ideally in a web-centric environment, and solid technical foundations. However, you should also have transitioned to AI-driven software development and adopted the mindset required to instruct and orchestrate AI-coding systems, versus writing code line by line.

In this role, you will help design, build and maintain our in-house Operating Platform that leverages AI-based coding, autonomous agents, and intelligent workflows to automatically enrich datasets, optimize processes, and enable smarter decision-making across the company.

Responsibilities
Own full-stack features built primarily via AI-Development tools
Define specs, requirements and interfaces for our platform
Orchestrate multi-step agent workflows, including planning, development, testing and documentation
Review, debug, and validate AI-generated code for production readiness
Continuously improve prompts, tools, and agent strategies
Requirements
Full-stack development experience in production systems
Experience with one or more DBMS or Datastore systems
Experience on *Nix-based systems
Experience with AWS
Solid understanding of standard web technologies (HTML, CSS, JS)
Shipped software where AI-Coding tools generated the majority of the code
Comfortable understanding, debugging and reviewing code you did not write
Strong systems thinking and failure-mode analysis
High agency and low ego toward “ownership of code”
Team-oriented attitude and familiarity and passion for working in distributed teams and in remote working environments
Strong ambition and a growth mindset
Candid and clear communication, with strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills
Bonus
Multi-agent workflows in real projects
Prompt/version control for production systems
Has opinions about when not to trust agents
Additional Requirements
Excellent command of English, both spoken and written
The position will require some travel

WHY JOIN BITKRAFT?

At BITKRAFT, we foster a collaborative and entrepreneurial culture where innovation thrives. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to work alongside passionate individuals who are driving the next wave of disruption in gaming, Web3, and immersive technologies.

We offer competitive compensation and opportunities for personal and professional growth in a dynamic and supportive work environment.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to join our Team Backoffice Platform at Pleo. In this role, you'll help us make the backoffice an accessible platform for engineers to contribute to, help us set up frontend guidelines, and address tech debt. If you're excited about innovating the most important internal tool and are passionate about frontend, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to
You’ll report to an Engineering Manager and work closely with teams in Quality Engineering and Demo Experience. Our team of 3 is highly collaborative and dedicated to backoffice. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across the company to ensure success.

What you’ll be doing 

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you will:

Lead initiatives to improve consistency in the UI/UX of backoffice
Collaborate with Backoffice Platform to create and improve features to support our users
Analyze usage metrics and adoption in order to inform future product decisions
Come opinionated but open to every meeting 
Mentor and guide more junior frontend developers within the organization

To put things into context, we currently have backoffice permissioning overhaul and external partner access on our roadmap. You can expect to work with the following tech stack and tools:

Modern JavaScript, CSS and Web APIs
Component-based, declarative UIs (we use React)
CSS-in-JS (we use styled-components)
Linting and testing frameworks (we use Jest + RTL and Vitest)
Static types (we use TypeScript)
Data fetching and mutations (we use tRPC, SWR)

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

A solid understanding of react, typescript, and working with design systems.
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with stakeholders and engineers.
A passion for solving problems in creative and innovative ways.
Excellent time management and the ability to prioritize tasks effectively.
Experience with grafana or a similar observability tool.
The willingness to learn and teach others
A background in B2B SAAS or FinTech

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

Like working in an autonomous and trusted team
Collaborate well with non-engineering users and engineers alike regardless of their specific role or level
Stay engaged
Love to learn

This role is not a good fit for you if:

Need everything documented in order to work
Lack initiative unless you’re told exactly what to work on
Gatekeep or enjoy working in a silo

How you’ll develop in this role
In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

Lead a large scale project to drive impact in backoffice and operations.
Collaborate with Team Backoffice Platform to reduce tech debt, improve auditability and facilitate backoffice technical contribution.
Grow your skills in a platform team, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale.

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in engineering.

The annual salary for this position varies based on your location:

United Kingdom: £80,000 - £85,000
Spain/Portugal: €95,800 - €101,800

We’re happy to share more about our approach to pay and this range during your first call with us!

Percona is looking for a Frontend Web Developer (Observability) to join its Open Source Software Development team.

Together with a dedicated and distributed team of engineers, you will be contributing to further enhancing and extending the “Percona Monitoring and Management” (PMM) product. This position is mostly web frontend programming but understanding some Go will help you in a better understanding of the backend of our product. As an open source company, we use the power of existing open source projects and also make our own contributions to popular repositories. The work is challenging, but that’s why it’s also fun and rewarding!

What You Will Do

We are looking for a user experience focused developer to help present complex infrastructure management capabilities to our users in an easy to understand but feature-rich manner. You will build interfaces that are capable of managing single nodes all the way to thousands of systems so being able to think both large and small scale will be critical. Our PMM product has both a monitoring and management component, so you’ll need to work across team boundaries to ensure that our software works together to make the users’ lives easier.

Your Experience

Good command of TypeScript and React

Experience with unit and integration testing

Familiarity with build tools (vite, webpack, etc.)

Knowledge of CSS frameworks

Various charting libs (d3, Highcharts or similar)

Good with Math and Statistics

Agile practices (deliver working code regularly)

UI/UX theory and practice

Git and GitHub

Docker or Podman experience

Excellent written and verbal English

What Will Make You Stand Out

Having Grafana or Prometheus experience will be a huge plus

Experience building web apps

Experience with container orchestration systems such as Kubernetes or OpenShift

Database experience in any of MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL or Valkey/Redis

Why Percona?

At Percona, we believe an open world is a better world. Our mission is to enable everyone to innovate freely, by providing the best open source database software, support, and services. We make databases and applications run better through a unique combination of expertise and open source software built with the community for you. Our technical teams are experts in MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB.

Percona is proud to be a remote-only and globally dispersed workforce – we have colleagues in more than 50 countries! We offer a collaborative, highly-engaged culture where your ideas are welcome and your voice is heard.

Our staff receives generous benefits including flexible work hours and various paid time off programs, all your equipment for your remote office, funds for career development (external training, certifications, conferences), ongoing connectivity allowances, and the opportunity to participate in our equity incentive plan. We also have benefits that support a healthy work/life balance such as The Percona Adventure Team, Work-from-Anywhere, FlowDays, FryDays, and overall flexibility. We also support being socially responsible through our PAVE volunteering program and Women Transforming Technology.

If you love the idea of working with a high-growth tech company that is one of the best in the business and known globally as a leader in the open-source database space, let’s talk!
